Cards.Name: The Second City
Cards.Text:
Each of your cards that is Courtier or Magistrate has +1F.
Political Open, Bow this card: Target a face-down card in a Province. You claim a new tract of land. Turn the face-down card face-up. You may increase the Province's strength by 2.
